bio.subtitle: A designer who writes code. A systems engineer with typographic intuition and visual discernment.
bio.totemDesc: Sculptural brand totem inspired by Urfa Nahit stone masonry and ancient solar dials.
bio.quote: Design is the elimination of excess. Urfa's ancient stone walls teach us one thing:
bio.quoteHighlight: Only that which withstands time endures.
bio.narrativeP1: In the digital landscape, most products get trapped in one of two extremes: visually stunning yet fragile, inaccessible, and sluggish websites; or rock-solid backend systems stripped of typographic grace, soul, and emotion.
bio.narrativeP2: I reject this artificial division. I engineer interfaces deterministically with strict performance and accessibility boundaries, while architecting systems with an artisan's rhythm, micro-interaction, and tactile presence.
bio.narrativeFocus: [ CORE FOCUS: CREATIVE FRONTEND · HIGH-THROUGHPUT BACKEND · RADIX / TAILWIND DESIGN SYSTEMS · WASM ]
